title: Koala
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx="24" cy="30" r="13" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="30" r="13" fill="#9aa3ad"/>
    <circle cx="24" cy="30" r="7" fill="#e8c9c9"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="30" r="7" fill="#e8c9c9"/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="26" ry="22" fill="#b6bec7"/>
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="80" rx="17" ry="15" fill="#d9dfe5"/>
    <!-- arms -->
    <ellipse cx="27" cy="74" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#a4acb6" transform="rotate(-12 27 74)"/>
    <ellipse cx="73" cy="74" rx="7" ry="12" fill="#a4acb6" transform="rotate(12 73 74)"/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="26" fill="#b6bec7"/>
    <!-- face patch -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="56" rx="17" ry="14" fill="#d9dfe5"/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx="40" cy="44" r="5" fill="#2c2f36"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="44" r="5" fill="#2c2f36"/>
    <circle cx="41.5" cy="42.5" r="1.7" fill="#fff7e0"/>
    <circle cx="61.5" cy="42.5" r="1.7" fill="#fff7e0"/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="54" rx="7" ry="6" fill="#3a3d45"/>
    <ellipse cx="48" cy="52" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#6a6f7a"/>
    <!-- mouth -->
    <path d="M44 61 Q50 65 56 61" stroke="#8a939c" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
